title: Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) Preventive Maintenance and Repair Services, and Isolation Power Panel Inspection
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF > 255-NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 15 (36C255)
description:
The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) requires a qualified contractor to provide all labor, materials (except as provided in Section 6), equipment, tools, supervision, transportation, and technical expertise necessary to perform inspection, testing, preventive maintenance, repair, and emergency response services for the Automatic Transfer Switches (ATS) and Isolation Electrical Power Panels listed in Attachment A at the Dwight D. Eisenhower VA Medical Center. All work shall ensure safe, reliable, and code-compliant operation of the equipment. 

 The contractor shall provide inspection, maintenance, testing, repair, and reporting services for all equipment in Attachment A at the frequencies stated in Section 5. 

 See attached document for details.
